first_comment: What fruit should we try next? 🍊👇
sources: Lemon cell: zinc and copper electrodes in citric acid give about 0.9 V; several cells in series light an LED (Exploratorium / Royal Society of Chemistry classroom experiments)
Red LEDs need roughly 1.8-2 V forward voltage (manufacturer datasheets, e.g. Kingbright)
